title: Fail-Safe and human obsolescence

tellings.quote: it's based on a novel um failafe. Okay. And I think it was originally made in like 196364.

plain: A film based on the novel Fail-Safe, a Cold War story about a nuclear crisis, is said to show how humans fall behind the machines they build. James Madden, a guest who talks about Plato's cave and consciousness, tells Michels this and dates it to around 1963 or 1964. He links it to the philosopher Günther Anders, who wrote about human obsolescence, the idea that our own technology leaves us behind.
